method: For each of the 14 hypotheses, compare package classification to the underlying contrast; assess whether it is freshly discriminated in 002 or asserted from hardcoded/historical/derived evidence.
summary: 9 of 14 are supported by fresh single-variable/within-arm contrasts; 3 are hardcoded/historical (071) attributions; 2-3 are derived from composite evidence. The primary-cause findings (retrieval, safe-refusal heuristic) are robust.
